about.title: About Openfans
about.whatIsDesc: Openfans is a Web3-based decentralized fan economy platform. We combine embodied AI robot Eve, P2P direct connection, and token economy to create a new way for creators and fans to connect.
about.visionDesc: Let everyone have their own AI companion, let creators' value return to creators. Openfans is committed to building a new decentralized fan economy ecosystem where humans and AI coexist.
about.eveDesc: Eve is Openfans' core hardware product, featuring silicone skin, high-DOF joints, and advanced AI personality models for natural conversation, emotion recognition, health monitoring, and smart home control.
about.featureP2PDesc: Peer-to-peer encrypted connection without central servers. Direct communication between creators and fans with low latency and strong privacy.
about.featureEveDesc: Embodied silicone robot with advanced AI personality models. Supports multi-personality switching, deep conversation, and health monitoring.
about.featurePersonalityDesc: Community creators can publish custom personality models. Gentle girlfriend, scholarly intellectual, energetic girl-next-door… there is one for everyone.
about.featureTokenDesc: Blockchain-based token system. Fan tips, creator monetization, personality trading — all on-chain and transparent.
about.featurePrivacyDesc: End-to-end encrypted communication, local-first data storage. User data sovereignty belongs to users, not the platform.
about.featureDAODesc: DAO governance — major decisions voted by the community. Platform revenue distribution transparent, creators receive fair returns.
